Visiting

Photos & sunset at Pantai Carocok

This beach’s value lies in the relationship between the shore, bay waters, and the small islands facing Painan. This page helps you photograph safely and politely.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Timing

Best light

Morning and dusk give soft light and reflections on the bay. Dusk is popular for watching the sky change colour above the small islands.

  • Dusk: position facing west at the bay edge.
  • Morning: calm light for quiet beach photos.
  • Avoid harsh midday for flatter colour.

Angle

Safe spots

Use available photo areas and do not climb structures or the jetty for an angle. Leave space for residents and beach activity.

Visual etiquette

Ask permission if photographing people, and do not disturb residents or beach operators.

Gear

Without heavy gear

A phone is enough for most shots. Bring a small support if you want long exposure at dusk, and watch the tide when shooting the water edge.

Questions

Before you go

01What time is sunset at Pantai Carocok?+

Sunset time changes daily and by season. Check a local app or forecast on the day of your visit; we do not list a fixed hour.

02Where is the best photo spot?+

The bay edge facing west gives a view toward the small islands. Use safe areas and do not climb structures.

03May I photograph from the jetty?+

The jetty is an operational area; do not climb or block activity. Ask staff if unsure.

04Do I need photo permission?+

General landscape photography usually no, but ask if photographing people or resident activity.
